title: Measure every room
detail: Record width, length, and ceiling height. Note doors, windows, and radiators.

title: Choose a sample layout or draw your own
detail: Start from the design library, then adjust room sizes to match your home.

title: Select an interior style
detail: Modern, traditional, minimalist, or industrial — use it as a palette, not a rule.

title: Place furniture in the room planner
detail: Check circulation: leave about 0.8 m for walkways where you can.

title: Compare flooring, paint, and worktops
detail: Match appearance, maintenance, and durability to each room's use.

title: Run quantity calculators
detail: Estimate paint, tiles, and flooring with a waste allowance.

title: Enter local prices in the budget planner
detail: Replace suggested prices with quotes from nearby suppliers.

title: Export a backup of your plan
detail: Download JSON so you can import it later on this or another browser.

title: Order flooring samples
detail: View oak, vinyl, or tile in your actual daylight before buying.

title: Paint tester patches
detail: Try colours on two walls — north and south light will differ.

title: Get a worktop template or quote
detail: Quartz and stone need a templater; laminate can be cut from drawings.

title: Order flooring with waste
detail: Use the calculator packs/tiles count; keep leftover for repairs.

title: Buy paint and primer
detail: Match litres from the estimate; add a small tin for touch-ups.

title: Order tiles, grout, and adhesive
detail: Confirm tile size matches the calculator assumptions.

title: Confirm furniture lead times
detail: Sofas and kitchens often arrive after decorating — sequence the work.

title: Protect existing floors and furniture
detail: Dust sheets and film before sanding or painting.

title: Paint ceilings and woodwork first
detail: Then walls. Allow drying time between coats.

title: Lay or fit flooring
detail: Acclimatise timber and vinyl. Keep expansion gaps as specified.

title: Tile wet rooms
detail: Waterproofing and falls in showers are specialist work if you are unsure.

title: Place furniture to the plan
detail: Use the 2D layout as a guide, then adjust for real sockets and doors.

title: Add rugs, curtains, and lamps
detail: These finish a style more than extra ornaments.

title: Walk through with the report
detail: Check leftover materials are stored and the plan backup is saved.
